Welcome to SavageGods!

SavageGods is a story telling game where the players collectively try and build a compelling fantasy world involving gods, demigods, races and heroes. https://kumu.io/Phyra/sg#ecosystem

## 0. Rules

1. No Metagaming Do not use your Aye / Nay to gain an advantage, don't get personal 2. The Subverse is Canon META and IRC hold no value 3. No Repeat Actions If an action has failed the player can not repost it. 4. No creation of new elements in the comments. Play with the pieces on the board. 5. Chaosbot's word is final.

---------------------- ## 1. The vote

Every player always has a voice. This voice determines wheter the story in the OP is deemed fitting for the story we are trying to build.

If you feel a player has written a good story and you like the post leave an [](#aye)

`[](#aye)`

If you feel the player's story would disrupt the game or take it in an unwanted direction, leave a [](#nay)

`[](#nay)`

The ratio of Aye and Nay will determine the probability for the post to pass.

-----

## 2. SavageryTM

Each God, Demigod, Race & Hero starts the Game with [30 Savagery](https://i.sli.mg/zqd0tJ.png).

Players can spend their Savagery to boost the powerlevel of actions.

[Each week](https://i.sli.mg/rLyLmu.png) each actively controlled God, Demigod, Race & Hero gains 10 Savagery, not to exceed 30.

If you claim another character, your old character will not gain the +10. Your new claim will gain the +10.

To spend savagery on an action make sure to say X [](#sv)

`[](#sv)`

### 2.1 What is worth free [](#sv)

* Your original post is worth 1 [](#sv) and 1 [](#aye) in your favour. * A reply with Bless, Curse, Aid or Sabotage is worth 1 [](#sv) * If you use one or several permanents, you get their SV strength. * The modifiers awarded to you are worth 1 [](#sv)

### 2.2 Modifiers If a modifier applies you will receive it at the discretion of the mods. The modifier is mandatory. You can receive modifiers on actions and blessings/curses

Examples of modifiers

* Domains * Combat Advantages * Plot Armour * Special Rules * ...

When gods have conflicting domains, the more specific domain wins the domain bonus.

>Awry, God of Mischief tries to steal something. His domain is relevant and so the action would start at 2 savagery. However Valdi, God of Thieves dislikes the action and tries to sabotage it. Awry will not get the +1 Domain bonus. The action will be at 1 savagery and the sabotage at 2 savagery.

When races are evenly matched, certain advantage might not be awarded to either one.

----- ## 3. Powerscaling

Powerscale | Type --- | --- 10 | Gods & Realms 5 | Demigods & Artifacts 1 | Everything else

If interactions happens between things of a different powerscale this multiplier will be applied.

>Example: A Race tries to stop a God, the race's Savagery will count as 1/10 * Savagery spent.

------------------------- ## 4. The players

### 4.1 God

[A God has 3 domains.](https://i.sli.mg/77w4jY.png) In each of these domains they get +1 Savagery.

Gods can:

* Create Artefacts * Create Demigods * Create Races & Fauna * Create Realms * Curse & Bless, Aid & Sabotage anything in the game.

Gods are not allowed to directly smite Demigods, Heroes, Races.

* If the Savagery of a God falls to Zero, the god has been banished to the void and needs to [wait 2 Sabbats to return](https://i.sli.mg/Xxedzz.png). They then return with 10 Savagery. In the meantime the player can claim another character.

### 4.2 Demigods

A Demigod has 1 domain of limited scope. In this domain they get +1 Savagery.

[A Demigod starts with the Savagery it was created with, this Creation Value will reflect it's strength.](https://i.sli.mg/Fnbqcp.png)

Demigods can:

* Perform actions in their limited domain * Attack Gods, Demigods, Heroes, Races * Curse/Bless/Aid/Sabotage non god actions

Demigods cannot create Artefacts, Realms or Demigods.

* If the Savagery of a Demigod falls to Zero it is destroyed forever.

### 4.3 Heroes

[A hero starts with 30 Savagery](https://i.sli.mg/OqfTug.png)

A Hero as plot armor and gets +1 savagery on everything he does as well as reducing the damage he takes by 1 savagery.

Heroes can:

* Discover & Use Artefacts * Heroes can ascend to become Demigods & retain Hero traits * Heroes can learn Magic, Combat, Artefact Control, Technology * Attack Demigods & Heroes * Lead a war effort of a race * Aid or Sabotage a race or hero

Heroes cannot do God or Demigod things.

* If the Savagery of a Hero falls to Zero, the Hero dies. He can be resurrected by a god infusing him with new Savagery.

### 4.4 Races

A race player can have multiple heroes, these heroes cannot ascend.

A Race starts with 30 Savagery. The Savagery they were created with will reflect the strength of their first stronghold.

Races can:

* Expand their strongholds * Expand their economy * Develop technology * Train armies * Attack Races, Heroes & Demigods * Aid or Sabotage a race or hero

Races cannot do God or Demigod things.

* If a Race loses all strongholds the race becomes extinct.

More info about Races in the comments.

## 5. Permanents Anything that is on the board hold their Creation Value and their Powerscaling.

* [Armies](https://i.sli.mg/57376l.png) * Strongholds * Fauna * Weapons * [Artefacts](https://i.sli.mg/SIBmZz.png) * Demigods * Special Rules from Curses & Blessings * .....

Players can build on what has been created in future posts where they add to it. You can only further strengthen something you could create

Using a permanent in an action will have it's Creation Value as a modifier in your favor.

------------------------ ## 6. How does it all work?

### 6.1 A topic

Everything starts with a nicely written story about your endeavors in our universe. You may make the post as prozaic as you want.

At the end of your post we want you to write out in plain language what the intended effects are, how much SV you spend to make it happen and what your remaining total is.

The extents of what you can do are determined by the other players on the subverse. The other players will read your story and decide if they think this is a good addition to the universe. If your post get's too many Nay's it is likely to fail and the game will continue as if your story never happened.

If the post is accepted the Arbiters will make up a summary, that summary will become cannon.

If the post fails, none of it happened, no one lost or gained anything.

### Secrets

A secret action has a 5% chance of being discovered. Discovered secrets open up interaction to all other players.

Otherwise the action is flaired as Secret. What happens in secret actions cannot be use by the other players to metagame against you. Other players cannot interfere with your secret action.

If you wish you can share a secret action with other players, the players part of a secret may interact.

### 6.2 The comments Comment Layout: https://voat.co/v/MardyMustDie/comments/1005664 ~~~ [](#type of comment)

-----

[](#vote)

For when you do something miscellaneous in the comments, like equiping 3 or you armies with a certain weapon when preparing to defend your fort. This is the label if you want to evolve a story, subsequent players don't need to label.

------ [](#bless) & [](#aid)

----- Gods and demigods can strengthen the actions of others with a blessing. Races and heroes can aid other races and heroes.

Write a story about what extra benefit occurs and strengthen it by spending [](#sv)

The other players can aye/nay vote on this to decide the chance of it happening. The final result will be decided by Chaosbot.

* For each bless and aid the result is **added** to the Savagery total of the target, the special rules are added to the target.

~~~ [](#bless) [](#aid) ~~~

----- [](#curse) & [](#sabotage)

-----

You can also weaken and provide caveats to the original creating by placing a curse or by sabotage.

Write a story about what happens with the action that weakens it and make the effect stronger by spending [](#sv)

The other players can vote aye/nay on this to determine the chance it passes. The result will be decided by Chaosbot.

* For each curse and sabotage the result is **substracted** from the Savagery total of the target, the special rules are added to the target.

~~~ [](#curse) [](#sabotage) ~~~ -----

### 7 The decision making

### 7.1 General decision making. This applies to all posts, curses, blessings,...

Once 24 Hours has past the arbiters will count up all visible [](#aye) , [](#nay) and then they will count the total [](#sv) for the action.

Then our Chaosbot, programmed by @failure, will decide the end result in IRC by using the command

`!sv aye nay sv`

The Aye/Nay turn into a probability for the post to pass. Chaosbot will tell if the post was a Succes or not.

Then he will return a Savagery outcome for the action. The outcome is picked at random from a scaled [Gauss graph](http://curvebank.calstatela.edu/gaussdist/normal.jpg) with *mu = sv* and *sigma = sv/4*

### 7.2 Conflict posts For damaging actions ##### POWERSCALING APPLIES, BE CAREFULL!

In a conflict post players need to say what they use and what they target. In the comments, each player says what they use and who they target. Each player can only attack *one thing* in a conflict post.

Players can also Aid, Sabotage, Bless or Curse the players involved in a conflict. These will be applied before resolution.

The attacks will then be executed chronologically to post date, when the target strikes back, the attack resolves simultaneously.

The targets will lose their respective damage received in Savagery.

**Autodefend** - The player targetted in the original thread automatically strikes back at his agressor if the player is AFK.

8.2 Technology

A race can develop technology. Technology is anything a race could invent, ranging from the plow to carbon fibre surfboards, alcoholic drinks, etc... Trained fauna and flora, weapons, armour and other combat items as well as all Magic, spells, techniques, powers. Anything you can invent or produce as a race is Technology

The technology you create can have a creation value and a special rule. Once you create technology you cannot lose it.

You can trade technology with other races. Giving both races acces to both technologies. If the Trade Routes are cut of or diplomacy falls through your acces to traded technology is lost.

8.3 Militaries

A race can create military units. You can create as many as you want. Each military unit is unique and can be equipped with technology.

Races can use their technology to strengthen their armies. If a race has an army of 3SV and a spear of 2SV they can outfit that army with the spear and get an army of 5SV.

You have tamed a species of monsters, you can now have an army ride those monsters into battle. The military units Savagery value increases by the value of the technology.
